description: "My First Picture Book" by Joseph Martin Kronheim is a children's illustrated book created in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This publication features a collection of traditional nursery rhymes and stories, aimed at serving as an introduction to literature for young readers.

authorInfo.bio: Joseph Martin Kronheim (1810–1896) was a German-born lithographer and wood engraver known for founding Kronheim & Co. and working with George Baxter.
